Under the 8-shard matrix the selector rejected all 24 candidate schedule runs, every one a whole green 6-shard run. The fix now reads each run at **its own** width: `runShardWidth` takes M from the run's `Test Core (N/M)` job names, and the download loop walks that run's own artifacts, so a matrix resize has no transition window. A run whose jobs disagree on M, or that has no Test Core job, is refused by name. A new 9-case battery covers this, with a firing control: the same 6-shard run pinned to 8 is rejected. There is also an accumulation leg over mixed 8- and 6-wide runs. The "why six" and "why not more" comments are rewritten with the new readings, not deleted.

- `timeout-minutes` 50 → 60, from the headroom tool over 512 `Test Core (N/6)` jobs. Fifty was already short at six (worst p+s 40m27s, cap-deferred path 60.45m). Scaled to eight, the cap-deferred verdict is 56m37s. The revert condition is restated at 60.
